name: clickhouse-loom
description: Shared long-term memory, document search and a code index for Cursor from a self-hosted ClickHouse Loom server, over MCP, with the loom and loom-code skills that say when to recall, save and ask the code index.

LOOM_MCP_URL.title: Loom MCP URL
LOOM_MCP_URL.description: Your Loom server's MCP endpoint: http://localhost:7777/mcp?toolset=coding when each member runs a single-user server, or https://<your server>/mcp for a team server with browser sign-in
